title: Conch Salad
description: This fresh conch salad with plenty of citrus flavor is a refreshing prelude to any Caribbean-themed meal.
ingredients: 0.25 teaspoon seasoning blend (such as Badia® Complete Seasoning®), or to taste
1 pinch seasoned salt, or to taste
1 dash hot sauce, or to taste

steps.text: Tenderize conch with a meat mallet. Cut into bite-sized chunks; transfer to a glass bowl. Add 1 cup lemon juice; cover bowl with plastic wrap. Soak conch in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, preferably overnight.
Drain off and discard lemon juice. Transfer conch to another bowl. Add tomatoes, onion, bell pepper, cucumber, seasoning blend, and seasoned salt; mix thoroughly.

Transfer conch mixture to a container. Add tomato juice, remaining 1/4 cup lemon juice, and lime juice; mix well. Stir in vinegar and hot sauce. Cover and refrigerate until flavors combine, about 1 hour. Serve cold.
